metadata.description: Exchanges and trading services with REST API support, UDF compatibility, and KYC requirements. Feeds the setup wizard.

exchanges.name: BitMEX
exchanges.apiManagementNotes: API Key + HMAC Signature authentication. Full REST and WebSocket support. Offers a testnet environment for safe testing.

exchanges.name: Binance
exchanges.apiManagementNotes: API Key + HMAC Signature + IP whitelisting. Extensive SDK support in multiple languages. Testnet available.

exchanges.name: KuCoin
exchanges.apiManagementNotes: API Key + HMAC Signature + API Passphrase. Unified account trading supported.

exchanges.name: OKX
exchanges.apiManagementNotes: Unified V5 API. REST + WebSocket support. Highly structured documentation.

exchanges.name: Bybit
exchanges.apiManagementNotes: REST + WebSocket. USDT and USDC perpetuals supported.

exchanges.name: Kraken
exchanges.apiManagementNotes: API Key + HMAC Signature. FIX protocol support available for institutional traders.

exchanges.name: MEXC
exchanges.apiManagementNotes: No-KYC access is available but with strict withdrawal and trading limits for unverified users.
exchanges.officialDocsNote: spot_v3_en = LIVE api.mexc.com/api/v3 (verified 2026-09-09: 2080 markets, klines, ticker, depth). spot_v2_en describes the DEPRECATED /open/api/v2/* API (404 on live) — do not use; it made the AI extract dead endpoints (2026-09-09 MEXC wizard bug).

exchanges.name: CoinEx
exchanges.apiManagementNotes: Client library available for both REST and WebSocket integration.

exchanges.name: DigiFinex
exchanges.apiManagementNotes: Open API access with a tiered VIP system affecting rate limits.

exchanges.name: Ethereal
exchanges.apiManagementNotes: Built-in TradingView UDF-compatible API for OHLCV data. Fully on-chain and permissionless.

exchanges.name: Hyperliquid
exchanges.apiManagementNotes: No account creation needed (connect wallet). No withdrawal limits. Handles ~44% of all DEX perpetual volume.

exchanges.name: Apex Omni
exchanges.apiManagementNotes: CEX-like trading speed combined with on-chain settlement. Offers copy trading via API.

exchanges.name: AsterDEX
exchanges.apiManagementNotes: Supports extremely high leverage. Multichain DEX architecture.

exchanges.name: dYdX
exchanges.apiManagementNotes: Low fees and moderate liquidity. Operates on an on-chain order book with off-chain matching.

exchanges.name: Lighter
exchanges.apiManagementNotes: Focuses on permissionless trading volume.

exchanges.name: edgeX
exchanges.apiManagementNotes: Designed for permissionless, high-volume perpetual trading.

exchanges.name: Nobitex (نوبیتکس)
exchanges.apiManagementNotes: Public UDF endpoint: /market/udf/history (no token needed). Rate limit: 60 req/min. Official Python wrapper available.

exchanges.name: Wallex (والکس)
exchanges.apiManagementNotes: Official UDF endpoint: /v1/udf/history for OHLCV. Python, .NET, and Go SDKs available.

exchanges.name: Exir (اکسیر)
exchanges.apiManagementNotes: Uses HMAC-SHA256 authentication with headers: api-key, api-signature, api-expires. Node.js and Python libs available.

exchanges.name: Tabdeal (تبدیل)
exchanges.apiManagementNotes: Official Python and Go SDKs provided. Unofficial Python wrapper also available.

exchanges.name: Bitpin (بیت‌پین)
exchanges.apiManagementNotes: Base URL: https://api.bitpin.market. Community-developed Go SDK exists.

exchanges.name: Ramzinex (رمزینکس)
exchanges.apiManagementNotes: Two API bases: publicapi.ramzinex.com (public) and ramzinex.com (authenticated with headers). Python implementation available.

exchanges.name: OK Exchange (اوکی اکسچنج)
exchanges.apiManagementNotes: Iranian CEX founded in 2017. Offers REST API and WebSocket data feeds. Supports 700+ cryptocurrencies.

exchanges.name: BloFin
exchanges.apiManagementNotes: No-KYC with a daily withdrawal limit of 20,000 USDT.

exchanges.name: BYDFi
exchanges.apiManagementNotes: No-KYC with a daily withdrawal limit of 50,000 USDT.

exchanges.name: WEEX
exchanges.apiManagementNotes: No-KYC with a daily withdrawal limit of 50,000 USDT.

exchanges.name: Bitunix
exchanges.apiManagementNotes: High no-KYC limit: daily withdrawal up to 500,000 USDT.

exchanges.name: KCEX
exchanges.apiManagementNotes: No-KYC with a daily withdrawal limit of 15 BTC.

exchanges.name: IndoEx
exchanges.apiManagementNotes: No-KYC for spot trading. Withdrawal limit: 100 BTC daily. Supports 160+ cryptocurrencies.

exchanges.name: Houdini Swap
exchanges.apiManagementNotes: Privacy-enhanced swaps. Supports 100+ chains with no blockchain trace.

exchanges.name: 0x Swap API
exchanges.apiManagementNotes: Accesses 9M+ tokens across 16 EVM-compatible chains and 130+ exchanges.

exchanges.name: Quickex
exchanges.apiManagementNotes: Supports 200+ cryptocurrencies. No registration required.

exchanges.name: Godex
exchanges.apiManagementNotes: Supports 929+ cryptocurrencies. Non-custodial swap service.

exchanges.name: Eterna MCP
exchanges.apiManagementNotes: Built specifically for AI agents. Sandboxed TypeScript SDK with isolated sub-accounts.

exchanges.name: Southxchange
exchanges.apiManagementNotes: Cryptocurrency broker that does not require KYC. Accepts Lightning payments.

exchanges.name: VDEX
exchanges.apiManagementNotes: Omnichain hybrid exchange. Features a darkpool and full self-custody.
